title: Nepal’s Flood Relief Workers Feel the Pain of Trump’s Cuts to U.S.A.I.D.
summary: The agency played an important role in responding to earlier disasters like the 2015 earthquake. But the U.S. and other countries have pulled back, Nepali officials and humanitarian groups say.
